dataset_metadata.product_name: NASA CERES Energy Balanced and Filled (EBAF) TOA Edition 4.2
dataset_metadata.educational_disclaimer: CERES EBAF measures top-of-atmosphere shortwave solar reflection and longwave planetary thermal emission, calibrating the environmental heat sink for spacecraft thermal nodes.
dataset_metadata.attribution: NASA CERES Science Team / NASA LaRC ASDC

zonal_bands.notes: Low ocean albedo, high convective cloud longwave moderation
Moderate albedo from continental landmasses and storm tracks
High cryospheric reflection from sea ice and ice sheets, cold emission surface
